title: Container restart loop
symptom: docker compose ps shows api restarting every few seconds.
hints: Compare .env.example to the server env file
code:
api  | Error: JWT_SECRET is required
api exited with code 1
cause: A required environment variable is missing on the server, so the app exits on startup and Docker restarts it.
fix: Add JWT_SECRET to the server's env file (chmod 600), docker compose up -d, and add a startup config check with a clear error message.
verify: docker compose ps shows Up (healthy); /health returns 200.

title: Data lost on every restart
symptom: All bookings vanish after docker compose up -d --force-recreate.
cause: The database writes to the container's ephemeral layer.
fix: Add a named volume mapped to /var/lib/postgresql/data and declare it under volumes:. Restore data from backup.
verify: Create a row, recreate containers, the row persists.

title: HTTPS fails: wrong DNS record
symptom: Caddy logs 'challenge failed' and the browser shows ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR.
hints: Does it return your VPS IP?
cause: The A record points to an old IP, so Let's Encrypt validates the wrong server.
fix: Correct the A record, wait for TTL, then reload Caddy. Use dig @1.1.1.1 to check public propagation.
verify: curl -vI https://app.example.com shows a valid certificate; http redirects to https.

title: CORS only in production
symptom: Browser console: blocked by CORS policy; works locally.
cause: The production env still has the local origin, so the API doesn't allow the real frontend origin.
fix: WEB_ORIGIN=https://app.example.com (exact, no trailing slash); restart the API.
verify: Response contains Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://app.example.com and Allow-Credentials: true; login works.

title: Full disk from logs
fix: Truncate the file, set logging options max-size 10m / max-file 5 on each service, recreate containers, alert at 80% disk.
verify: After restart, log size stays bounded; disk alert test fires.
